tools.description: Check whether the Railway CLI is installed and if the user is logged in. This tool helps agents verify the Railway CLI setup before attempting to use other Railway tools.

tools.description: Create a new Railway environment for the currently linked project. Optionally duplicate an existing environment and set service variables.

duplicateEnvironment.description: The name of an existing environment to duplicate

environmentName.description: The name for the new environment

serviceVariables.description: Service variables to assign in the new environment (only works when duplicating)

workspacePath.description: The path to the workspace where the environment should be created

tools.title: Create Environment

workspacePath.description: The path to the workspace to create the project in

tools.title: Create Railway Project

tools.description: Upload and deploy from the current directory. Supports CI mode, environment, and service options.

ci.description: Stream build logs only, then exit (equivalent to setting $CI=true)

environment.description: Environment to deploy to (defaults to linked environment)

service.description: Service to deploy to (defaults to linked service)

workspacePath.description: The path to the workspace to deploy

tools.name: deploy
tools.title: Deploy to Railway

tools.description: Search and deploy Railway templates. This tool will search for templates using fuzzy search and automatically deploy the selected template to the current Railway project and environment.

searchQuery.description: Search query to filter templates by name, description, or category

templateIndex.description: Index of the template to deploy (required if multiple templates found)

workspacePath.description: The path to the workspace to deploy the template to

tools.name: deploy-template
tools.title: Deploy Railway Template

tools.description: Generate a domain for the currently linked Railway project. If a domain already exists, it will return the existing domain URL. Optionally specify a service to generate the domain for.

service.description: The name of the service to generate the domain for (optional)

workspacePath.description: The path to the workspace to generate domain for

tools.name: generate-domain
tools.title: Generate Railway Domain

tools.description: Get build or deployment logs for the currently linked Railway project. You can optionally specify a deployment ID, service, and environment. If no deployment ID is provided, it will get logs from the latest deployment. The 'lines' and 'filter' parameters require Railway CLI v4.9.0+. Use 'lines' to limit the number of log lines (disables streaming) and 'filter' to search logs by terms or attributes (e.g., '@level:error', 'user', '@level:warn AND rate limit'). For older CLI versions, these parameters will be ignored and logs will stream.

deploymentId.description: Deployment ID to pull logs from. Omit to pull from latest deployment

environment.description: Environment to view logs from (defaults to linked environment)

filter.description: Filter logs by search terms or attributes. Requires Railway CLI v4.9.0+. Examples: 'error', '@level:error', '@level:warn AND rate limit', 'user login', '@status:500'. See https://docs.railway.com/guides/logs for more info.

lines.description: Number of log lines to return (disables streaming). Requires Railway CLI v4.9.0+. Useful for searching through recent logs.

logType.description: Type of logs to retrieve: 'build' for build logs or 'deploy' for deployment logs

service.description: Service to view logs from (defaults to linked service)

workspacePath.description: The path to the workspace to get logs from

tools.name: get-logs
tools.title: Get Railway Logs

workspacePath.description: The path to the workspace to link the environment to
